test_cases.rationale: Health check endpoint should return true without authentication
Happy path - login with valid default credentials returns access token
Login with invalid credentials should return 400 error
Login missing required username field should return 422 validation error
Test token with invalid bearer token should return 401 unauthorized
Get users with invalid token should return 401 unauthorized
Get users with missing Authorization header should return 401
Get current user profile with invalid token should return 401
Update current user with invalid token should return 401
Update password with invalid token should return 401
Update password missing current_password with invalid token returns 401
Get user by UUID with invalid token should return 401
Get user by invalid UUID format should return 422 validation error
Create user with invalid token should return 401 unauthorized
User self-registration happy path; may return 403 if signup disabled
Get items with invalid token should return 401 unauthorized
Create item with invalid token should return 401 unauthorized
Create item missing required title with invalid token returns 401
Delete item with invalid token should return 401 unauthorized
Password recovery for existing email should return 200 with message
Probe signup crash with invalid email format to distinguish crash from disabled-signup 403
Probe password recovery with unknown email to confirm if crash is email-specific or endpoint-wide
Test token endpoint with no Authorization header at all to confirm 401 vs 403 behavior difference
Test reset-password with a bogus token to check for server crash similar to password-recovery endpoint
Login with valid username but wrong password to confirm proper 400 error and test credential validation path

evaluations.verdict: Test framework error, not an API bug
evaluations.resoning: The status 0 and null body indicate a test runner/validation error where the boolean true response could not be deserialized into the expected dict/list schema. The API likely returned the correct boolean true as per spec, but the test harness failed to handle it.
